description: Pin receipt for a large reference / training / baien dataset pinned to IPFS by the religious-corp dataset-pinner. Per ADR-2605241500. Parallels com.etzhayyim.substrate.ipfsPin (which is reserved for MST CAR shards from mst-projector). Readers can resolve `cid` from any IPFS gateway to obtain the original UnixFS tree; the optional `sha256` is an archive-level hash (deterministic tar of staging tree) that lets a consumer verify content independent of the IPFS chunker. Charter Rider §2(a)..(h) scan result (ADR-2605192200) MUST be recorded — pins where `charterRiderScan.passed = false` are NOT allowed and the pinner refuses to emit them.

name.description: Stable dataset name in canonical form, e.g. `HF:HuggingFaceTB/smollm-corpus` or `local:baien-graft-3d-260524`. Together with `revision` uniquely identifies a pin.

revision.description: Upstream revision pin. For HF datasets: the git revision SHA or tag. For HTTP sources: a content etag or capture timestamp. Free-form for `local-import`.

kind.description: Taxonomic bucket for sharding + storage policy.

cid.description: IPFS UnixFS root CID (v1, base32) returned by Kubo `/api/v0/add` (or equivalent provider call).

sizeBytes.description: Total byte size of the pinned tree (sum of leaf sizes, not including IPFS framing overhead).

sha256.description: Archive-level sha256 of a deterministic tar of the staging tree. Optional but recommended for chunker-independent verification.

providers.description: Names of pin providers that confirmed the pin. Production target ≥ 2 distinct providers (replication-factor invariant inherited from ADR-2605171800 Stage 4). Single-provider pins are allowed during bootstrap, marked by `replicationMin: 1` in the manifest row.

assignedNodes.description: DIDs of nodes that MUST hold this CID per the sharding plan. Empty array means unassigned (any node may pin opportunistically).

source.description: How the dataset was obtained upstream.

license.description: SPDX identifier or free-text license string. MUST be compatible with the Charter Compliance Rider (ADR-2605192200); first-party redistribution implies Apache-2.0 + Rider on derivative artifacts.

charterRiderScan.description: Result of kotodama.organism.sensors.charter_rider.scan() against a deterministic sample of the dataset. Required: pins with `passed = false` MUST NOT be emitted.

manifestRowRef.description: Reference back to the row in `90-docs/baien/datasets.jsonl` that this pin record corresponds to. Either a 1-based line number (string-encoded) or a git blob CID anchor — implementation-defined for Phase 1.
